methodology.runner: T8a playLife/financialDecisions unchanged; the only addition is PilotOptions.retrainAt. Decisions: hash32(economy-t8a, seed, storylet, age) as in T8a; no simulation RNG is consumed by policies.
methodology.switcher: From age 35, before other purchases of the year, attempt canBuy/purchase('retrain') to hash32('economy-t5', seed, 'retrain-target') % 3 among the three other professions. On refusal retry every year up to age 39.
methodology.groups: Switcher = Careerist policy (work focus, course whenever available) + retraining. SwitcherSaver = Saver policy (study focus, no purchases) + retraining. Controls use identical seeds and policies without retraining.
methodology.attribution: Paired differences isolate the retraining policy for the same seed, but downstream stories, checks and mortality may diverge after the switch. Joint-survivor checkpoints and joint-age wage sums are reported separately from lifetime totals.
methodology.narrative: Profession-gated storylets: microcrack/late-tech-handbook (Техник), clinic/late-medic-routine (Медик), seed-vault (Агроном), council (Координатор); moments m-job-*. Moments are offered via beat even when bots let them expire.
limitations: Bots are not players: the retraining target is a hash, not a preference for a profession.
Story mentor retraining (free, cyclic) still happens in some control and switcher lives; counted separately.
No rebalancing was performed; ECONOMY_TUNING and catalogue prices are unchanged.
Lifetime means include early deaths; switched-only statistics condition on reaching the switch.
